query: The Eel Story The old barge-man's eel story is the most famous story at the Newt. Regulars mouth along. The landlady says if you can tell it as well as he does, the room will be half yours. He's willing to teach it, slowly, for an evening. Learn it and tell it back You tell it back that same night, to the same corner, and get the laugh at the eel's second escape. The barge-man wipes his eyes and buys you a cider. You get the eel's name wrong and the ending backwards. The regulars are very kind about it, which is worse. Just enjoy the story You sit and listen to the eel story twice through, and laugh both times. You couldn't tell it, but you've rarely had a better evening.
